subject: PHYS
title: Physics – Form 4
source: Form 4 scheme of work 2026-27, 3 periods/week, 63 h a year; dates worked out from the week numbers

lessons.title: First contact and presentation of the scheme of work
1.1–1.2 Concept of heat and temperature; measurement of temperature
1.3–1.5 Thermometry: liquid-in-glass thermometer, calibration using fixed points
1.6 Clinical and laboratory thermometers
1.1–1.3 Calorimetry: heat capacity, specific heat capacity, calculations with Q = mcΔθ
1.4–1.5 Latent heat, specific latent heat, cooling effect
1.6 Heat transfer: conduction, convection and radiation
1.7 Thermal expansion: the bimetallic strip; radiant energy converters
2.1–2.3 Properties of waves: classification, reflection, refraction, diffraction, interference; v = fλ
2.4–2.6 Stationary waves, harmonics and overtones; inter-node distance and wavelength
2.7–2.8 Sound: production, transmission and characteristics (amplitude, frequency, pitch, quality, audibility limits)
2.9–2.10 Measuring the speed of sound (echo, gun firing); echo sounding of the sea bed
2.11 Vibrating strings: frequency against length, mass per unit length and tension
Forced vibration and resonance; measuring the speed of sound by resonance
The electromagnetic spectrum: production, detection, properties, uses and health hazards
3.1–3.6 Charges and their origins, basic law of electrostatics, Coulomb's law, electroscope, charging and discharging
3.7 Conductors and insulators; the coulomb
3.8 Force between charges; industrial uses of electrostatics (photocopying, painting)
3.9–3.10 Electricity and charge movement; using meters in circuits
3.11 E.m.f. and p.d.; sources of e.m.f.
3.12 Energy consumption: W = QV and P = VI
3.13 Electric circuits: components of a circuit network
3.14–3.15 Ohm's law and resistance; series and parallel networks and calculations

chapters.title: Module 3 – Electrical energy: power and house wiring

lessons.title: 3.16–3.17 DC and AC, transmission of electric current, power dissipated
3.18 Power consumed at home (kWh)
3.19 House wiring: ring and radial circuits
3.20 Fuses and their selection; safety precautions
3.21 The cathode ray oscilloscope
Technical drawing: realising a technical project; drawing and reading technical drawings
Cross-section of an object; ways of viewing an object (top view, side view)
Reading the plan of a construction sheet; drawing a building with its dimensions
